def count_people_white_uniform(image_path, model_name="tiny", padding=20):
    detection_result = tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=["baseball", "basket"], threshold=0.35, model_size=model_name, padding=padding)
    # Get all detected objects and their bounding boxes
    detected_objects = [obj for obj in detection_result if obj["label"] in ["baseball", "basket"]]
    
    # Count total people wearing white uniform and check if any other person is wearing a white uniform
    total_people = len(detected_objects)
    white_uniformed_people = sum(1 for person in detected_objects if person["color"] == "white")
    
    return total_people, white_uniformed_people
</command>
